historical_note: queries.v1 is a small synthetic labelled set, not a recovery of the historical 30-query benchmark. The historical +0.022 MRR figure attributed to raw-cosine prefixing is NOT reproduced by this harness. The raw-cosine delta in the report is the metric DIFFERENCE between the unprefixed and `search_query:`-prefixed query embeddings on this corpus; a near-zero delta on a synthetic set is expected and does not contradict the historical finding on the lost corpus.
